_comment: OPTIONAL and NOT required for this build. The recommended path is the terminal + tools/automation_helper.py (PyAutoGUI). This file only illustrates how you COULD wire a desktop-control MCP server into Cursor if you prefer MCP over the terminal helper. Replace the placeholder command/args with a real computer-use MCP server of your choice, then copy this to .cursor/mcp.json. The shipped helper needs no MCP.
